sources.title: Goblin vaults wiped out
sources.summary: Goblin wiped out ten of its vaults on 2026-08-10: their liquidity was closed into stores that holders withdraw from themselves. Withdrawals pay first come, first served, and most stores hold less than their shares are owed, so each holder counts for a pro-rata share.
sources.inclusionRule: R2: Goblin wiped out these vaults on 2026-08-10 (Hyperion position closed, deposits stopped, withdrawals open): the shares left are ended positions their holders withdraw themselves. Counted at each holder's pro-rata share of the vault's store (decided 2026-10-26); the rest of the claim is blocked.

protocolStatus.evidence: Goblin's admin called vaults::wipe_out on ten vaults on 2026-08-10, 07:53–08:03 UTC; each now carries vaults::ClearOut with able_to_deposit false and able_to_withdraw true. Goblin's other vaults and goAPT stay live.

howTo: If the shares are staked: 0x1ddda82f0491ef60282a1ae8c4c82908723f945f1f10b809dcf1b5b085f77b92::masterchef::withdraw(pool id, amount).

Then 0x19bcbcf8e688fd5ddf52725807bc8bf455a76d4b5a6021cfdc4b5b2652e5cd55::vaults::remove_as_pair(vault, shares), or withdraw in the Goblin app (goblin.fi/vault). Withdrawals pay first come, first served while the vault's store lasts.

run.scope: holders of the shares of the 10 vaults Goblin wiped out (current_fungible_asset_balances), and senders of masterchef::deposit, zap::zap_in_with_pair, zap::zap_in_with_pair_both_coin, zap::zap_in_with_pair_coin, zap::zap_in_with_single, zap::zap_in_with_single_coin on 0x1ddda82f0491ef60282a1ae8c4c82908723f945f1f10b809dcf1b5b085f77b92 (stakers)

sanity.check: counted <= store and owed <= what all shares are owed, per vault and token

sources.title: MOVE staked with a validator that stopped

howTo: In your wallet's staking view, unlock the stake from this validator, then withdraw it. With the validator out of the set, the withdrawal is available immediately.
Or call 0x1::delegation_pool::unlock(pool, amount), then 0x1::delegation_pool::withdraw(pool, amount).

run.scope: active_shares rows (shares > 0) in delegation pools whose validator state is inactive (4) at enumeration time

sanity.check: per pool: sum of delegator active stake <= stake::get_stake(pool).active
